''This sense of purpose may bring us back together!|President Gyr Keela|<ref name="Rogue Squadron 8">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 8|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 8]]</ref>}}
The '''Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy''', also known as the '''Mrlsst Planetary University''', was one of the leading institutions for applied sciences in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was was the primary institute of higher learning on [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]].

It was at this university that the former [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] Professor [[Rorax Falken]] undertook the [[Phantom Project]], which aimed to create a unique [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] that required very little energy to maintain and could resist the effects of gravity well projectors. In reality a smoke-screen designed to swindle the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] out of every credit it would pay, funds for the project were diverted to other research under Falken's control, which resulted in the university developing several other pieces of technology, including the [[Gravitic polarization beam]] and the technology for [[Mrlssti Laser Phantoms]].

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Taj Junak]] made his final stand against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] forces on the Academy grounds.
